---
title: Create a custom retention job
description: Create a generic data retention policy for your entire database using a custom job
products: [cloud, self_hosted]
keywords: [jobs, data retention]
---

import * as C from "@constants";
import { Callout } from "@stainless-api/docs/components";
import { NumberedList, NumberedItem } from "@components/NumberedList";
import DoWithAi from "@components/DoWithAi.astro";
import TestPlan from "@components/TestPlan.astro";

Per-{C.HYPERTABLE} [built-in retention policies](/build/data-management/data-retention/create-a-retention-policy) cover most cases. When you need one rule that walks every {C.HYPERTABLE} in the database, implement it with a custom {C.JOB}.

<DoWithAi />

<NumberedList>
<NumberedItem title="Create a procedure to drop old chunks">
Create a procedure that drops {C.CHUNK}s from any {C.HYPERTABLE} if they are older
than the `drop_after` parameter. To get all {C.HYPERTABLE}s, the
`timescaledb_information.hypertables` table is queried.

```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE generic_retention (job_id int, config jsonb)
LANGUAGE PLPGSQL
AS $$
DECLARE
  drop_after interval;
BEGIN
  SELECT jsonb_object_field_text (config, 'drop_after')::interval
    INTO STRICT drop_after;

  IF drop_after IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Config must have drop_after';
  END IF;

  PERFORM drop_chunks(
    format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name),
    older_than => drop_after
  ) FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables;
END
$$;
```
</NumberedItem>

<NumberedItem title={`Register the ${C.JOB} to run daily`}>
In the `config`, set `drop_after` to 12 months to drop {C.CHUNK}s containing data older than 12 months.

```sql
SELECT add_job('generic_retention','1d', config => '{"drop_after":"12 month"}');
```

<Callout variant="note">
You can further refine this policy by adding filters to your procedure. For
example, add a `WHERE` clause to the `PERFORM` query to only drop {C.CHUNK}s from
particular {C.HYPERTABLE}s.
</Callout>
</NumberedItem>
</NumberedList>

<TestPlan>
target: cloud, self-hosted

1. fork the service
2. [cloud] select the service
3. [self-hosted] run SQL: `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS timescaledb;`
4. run SQL: `CREATE TABLE sensors (time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, sensor_id INTEGER NOT NULL, reading DOUBLE PRECISION) WITH (tsdb.hypertable, tsdb.partition_column = 'time', tsdb.chunk_interval = '90 days');`
5. run SQL: `CREATE TABLE events (time TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL) WITH (tsdb.hypertable, tsdb.partition_column = 'time', tsdb.chunk_interval = '90 days');`
6. run SQL: `INSERT INTO sensors SELECT t, 1, extract(doy FROM t) FROM generate_series(now() - INTERVAL '2 years', now(), INTERVAL '1 day') AS t;`
7. run SQL: `INSERT INTO events SELECT t, 'tick' FROM generate_series(now() - INTERVAL '2 years', now(), INTERVAL '1 day') AS t;`
8. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks WHERE hypertable_name IN ('sensors', 'events') AND range_end < now() - INTERVAL '12 months' HAVING count(DISTINCT hypertable_name) = 2`
9. run SQL: `CREATE OR REPLACE PROCEDURE generic_retention (job_id int, config jsonb) LANGUAGE PLPGSQL AS $$ DECLARE drop_after interval; BEGIN SELECT jsonb_object_field_text (config, 'drop_after')::interval INTO STRICT drop_after; IF drop_after IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Config must have drop_after'; END IF; PERFORM drop_chunks( format('%I.%I', hypertable_schema, hypertable_name), older_than => drop_after ) FROM timescaledb_information.hypertables; END $$;`
10. run SQL: `SELECT add_job('generic_retention','1d', config => '{"drop_after":"12 month"}');`
11. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.jobs WHERE proc_name = 'generic_retention' AND schedule_interval = INTERVAL '1 day' AND (config->>'drop_after')::interval = INTERVAL '12 months'`
12. run SQL: `CREATE FUNCTION retention_job_id() RETURNS int AS $$ SELECT job_id FROM timescaledb_information.jobs WHERE proc_name = 'generic_retention' $$ LANGUAGE sql;`
13. run SQL: `CALL run_job(retention_job_id());`
14. expect no rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks WHERE hypertable_name IN ('sensors', 'events') AND range_end < now() - INTERVAL '12 months'`
15. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM timescaledb_information.chunks WHERE hypertable_name IN ('sensors', 'events') AND range_end > now() - INTERVAL '12 months' HAVING count(DISTINCT hypertable_name) = 2`
16. expect rows: `SELECT 1 FROM sensors WHERE time > now() - INTERVAL '1 month' LIMIT 1`
</TestPlan>
